messages.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

### Short answer
For an Aerospace / Defense radar workflow, the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits on the communications-radio side of the system, not as the radar echo or radar signature measurement instrument, because the cited CMX500 material supports LTE/5G/WLAN signaling, RF, protocol, application, callbox, and non-signaling verification use cases, while radar signature evaluation is only tied to MVG test solutions in the passages [13][15][16][30].
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow point | Fit for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Communications subsystem bring-up | Use it to emulate the network and connect the DUT for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN, RF, protocol, and application testing.[16] | The CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD.[16] |
| R&D verification before formal testing | Use it during R&D verification, including new bands, sensitivity testing, RF measurements, throughput, and non-signaling verification.[15] | The Callbox use cases include R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, CMX500 SRS RF measurements, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification.[15] |
| Callbox / connected-mode validation | Use it when the DUT must be placed into a controlled call or wireless link for RF-focused testing.[14] | The Callbox positioning says it is easy to set up, easy to get in a call, easy to test with, and focused on RF testing including 3GPP pre-conformance.[14] |
| Non-signaling test phase | Use it as part of the Non-Sig Testing phase, alongside Go-NoGo, Conformance, and R&D testing phases.[80] | The CMX500 Callbox source places Go-NoGo Testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing, and R&D Testing in the testing-phase context.[80] |
| UAV / platform communications validation | Use it if the A&D radar platform also has LTE, 5G, or Wi‑Fi UE-type communications that need signaling test, RF measurements, application tests, or protocol tests.[44] | The UAV signaling source says CMX500 provides LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling tests from 400 MHz to 8 GHz, including Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER, MIMO, IP throughput, Video, Audio, and Protocol test.[44] |
| Coexistence / de-sense checks around radar payloads | Use it when multiple communications technologies on the platform may interfere with each other and need de-sense validation.[47] | The UAV communications source says UAVs may use more than two communication technologies, these may cause mutual interference, and CMX500 can perform de-sense validation because it supports multiple communication technologies.[47] |
| Radar echo / target simulation | The cited Signaling / Non-signaling Tester passages do not place CMX500 as the radar echo generator or radar signature tool.[30][42] | MVG is described as providing antenna characterization, radar signature evaluation, and electromagnetic measurements, while AREG800A is described as an Automotive Radar Echo Generator with dynamic artificial object generation for FMCW radar.[30][42] |
### Practical placement
【推論】Place the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester after RF design bring-up and before or alongside EMC/EME validation when the radar platform also includes LTE, 5G, or WLAN links, because CMX500 supports network emulation, signaling, RF/protocol/application testing, and non-signaling verification, while A&D EMC/EME workflows include RF susceptibility and system-level electromagnetic effects.[7][13][15][16][66][80]
【推論】Do not position the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the main radar test instrument, because the passages tie radar signature evaluation to MVG and radar echo generation to AREG800A, while the CMX500 passages tie it to cellular/WLAN signaling, RF, protocol, application, and non-signaling verification.[13][15][16][30][42]

2025RS Drone Solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是由 `2025RS Drone Solution.pdf` 轉出的 lossy markdown，標題為 `DRONE TEST SOLUTION PROPOSAL`；來源檔名含 `2025RS`，但正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、版本或簡報完整封面。
- 來源以 [[EMC]] / [[EME]] 為主軸，說明 drone / [[UAV]] / [[UAS]] 在 residential、outdoor AUT、MIL battle environment 與 multi-domain operations 下會遭遇不同電磁干擾與測試需求。
- 來源定義 [[UAV]] 為 platform vehicle，[[UAS]] 為支援 drone operation 的整體系統，包含 UAV、controller、datalink、sensors 等；並列出 battery、[[BMS]]、[[ESC]]、[[Flight Control Module]]、[[Communication Module]]、antennas 與 sensors 等 drone components。
- 來源提出 [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]]：standard system 包含 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]、[[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS8997]]；customised solution 包含 [[B-RID Environment Performance]]、[[CUAS System Performance Verification]]、[[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[High-Intensity RF]]。
- 商用無人機部分，來源列出 [[European EMC Directive]] 2014/30/EU、[[Radio Equipment Directive]] 2014/53/EU、[[ETSI EN 301 489]] 系列、[[CISPR 32]] / [[EN 55032]]、[[CISPR 35]]、[[EN 61000-4-3]]、[[EN 61000-4-6]]、[[EN 61000-4-2]]、[[EN 61000-4-4]]、[[EN 61000-4-5]]、[[EN 61000-4-11]]、[[EN 61000-3-2]]、[[EN 61000-3-3]] 與 [[ISO 7637-2]] 等線索。
- 軍用 / 航太部分，來源列出 [[MIL-STD-461]]、[[MIL-STD-464]]、[[RTCA DO-160]]、[[DEF STAN 59-411]]、[[GJB 151B]]、[[GJB 1389A]] 等標準線索，並補充 [[MIL-STD-464]] 涵蓋 external RF EME、[[HPM]]、[[EMP]]、lightning、RADHAZ、HERP / HERF / HERO、electrical bonding、TEMPEST 與 platform radiated emission 等系統層議題。
- 來源指出 commercial drone radiated RF immunity default test level 為 3 V/m、frequency range 80 MHz to 6 GHz，但也問「Is this test level adequate for all environment?」，並指出 test level 需由 drone manufacturer 依 applications 定義，例如 higher test level 10 V/m 或 specialized test level。

2025RS Drone Solution › 原文未解的問題
- 來源未標示正式發布日期、版本、作者、客戶、適用國家 / 地區或簡報完整頁數；只能以 raw 轉檔日期 2026-09-17 與檔名 `2025RS` 追溯。
- 轉檔為 lossy derivative；多個表格與標準列名存在 OCR / 排版斷裂，例如 standards based on EUT、R&S test system list、ETSI 4709-x 描述與 MIL / satellite standards 表。
- [[R&S TS8997]] 只出現代碼；來源未說明完整產品名稱或用途。
- [[MIL-STD-464]] 在來源中同時出現 464C 與 464D，未說明版本差異或適用情境。
- `Lighting` / `Lightning` 在來源中皆出現，需回 PDF 判斷是 illumination 還是 lightning / EMP 語境。
- `DAV-B` 可能為 `DVB` 或其他 broadcast emission 文字；未決。
- [[ETSI 4709-x]] 的正式標準名稱、版本與 drone network testing 關係未由來源清楚標示。
- 來源列出的 standard applicability 不等於任一 drone product 必須全部測試；測試項目需依 EUT、intended environment、regulatory domain、application 與 manufacturer requirement 定義。

### Short answer
For an Aerospace / Defense radar workflow, the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits on the communications-radio side of the system, not as the radar echo or radar signature measurement instrument, because the cited CMX500 material supports LTE/5G/WLAN signaling, RF, protocol, application, callbox, and non-signaling verification use cases, while radar signature evaluation is only tied to MVG test solutions in the passages [13][15][16][30].
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow point | Fit for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Communications subsystem bring-up | Use it to emulate the network and connect the DUT for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN, RF, protocol, and application testing.[16] | The CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD.[16] |
| R&D verification before formal testing | Use it during R&D verification, including new bands, sensitivity testing, RF measurements, throughput, and non-signaling verification.[15] | The Callbox use cases include R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, CMX500 SRS RF measurements, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification.[15] |
| Callbox / connected-mode validation | Use it when the DUT must be placed into a controlled call or wireless link for RF-focused testing.[14] | The Callbox positioning says it is easy to set up, easy to get in a call, easy to test with, and focused on RF testing including 3GPP pre-conformance.[14] |
| Non-signaling test phase | Use it as part of the Non-Sig Testing phase, alongside Go-NoGo, Conformance, and R&D testing phases.[80] | The CMX500 Callbox source places Go-NoGo Testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing, and R&D Testing in the testing-phase context.[80] |
| UAV / platform communications validation | Use it if the A&D radar platform also has LTE, 5G, or Wi‑Fi UE-type communications that need signaling test, RF measurements, application tests, or protocol tests.[44] | The UAV signaling source says CMX500 provides LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling tests from 400 MHz to 8 GHz, including Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER, MIMO, IP throughput, Video, Audio, and Protocol test.[44] |
| Coexistence / de-sense checks around radar payloads | Use it when multiple communications technologies on the platform may interfere with each other and need de-sense validation.[47] | The UAV communications source says UAVs may use more than two communication technologies, these may cause mutual interference, and CMX500 can perform de-sense validation because it supports multiple communication technologies.[47] |
| Radar echo / target simulation | The cited Signaling / Non-signaling Tester passages do not place CMX500 as the radar echo generator or radar signature tool.[30][42] | MVG is described as providing antenna characterization, radar signature evaluation, and electromagnetic measurements, while AREG800A is described as an Automotive Radar Echo Generator with dynamic artificial object generation for FMCW radar.[30][42] |
### Practical placement
【推論】Place the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester after RF design bring-up and before or alongside EMC/EME validation when the radar platform also includes LTE, 5G, or WLAN links, because CMX500 supports network emulation, signaling, RF/protocol/application testing, and non-signaling verification, while A&D EMC/EME workflows include RF susceptibility and system-level electromagnetic effects.[7][13][15][16][66][80]
【推論】Do not position the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the main radar test instrument, because the passages tie radar signature evaluation to MVG and radar echo generation to AREG800A, while the CMX500 passages tie it to cellular/WLAN signaling, RF, protocol, application, and non-signaling verification.[13][15][16][30][42]

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

MVG › 來源中的公司描述
依 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]] 與 [[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]]：

- [[MVG]] 的全名為 Microwave Vision Group。
- 提供 cutting-edge technologies for visualizing electromagnetic waves。
- 其 advanced test solutions 用於 antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements。
- 支援 company R&D teams innovate and boost product development。
- 營運於 10 個國家。
- 90% sales from exports。
- Group revenues exceeding €100 million。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

UAV signaling test solution › CMX500 可涵蓋的 signaling test 範圍
依 [[Signaling test solution]]，[[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 400 MHz 至 8 GHz，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的 signaling test。來源列出的測試類別包含：

- 基本 RF 量測：Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- Application layer test：IP throughput、Video、Audio。
- Protocol test。

使用限制：來源未說明 test case、standard version、release、channel bandwidth、MIMO layers、OTA / conducted setup、automation interface、pass / fail limit 或 measurement uncertainty。

UAV 通訊 › 多技術整合與 De-sense 驗證
[[Signaling test solution]] 指出 UAV 可能使用兩種以上通訊技術，其間可能造成相互干擾；[[R&S CMX500]] 因支援多種通訊技術，可進行 De-sense validation。

來源給出的配置原則是：software options 合併 5G 與 Wi‑Fi 測試表格，hardware 以滿足兩者中最大的 carrier aggregation 或 [[MIMO]] 作為配置。來源同時提醒「配置如有疑問請與 1C PM 確認」。

限制：來源未提供 De-sense 的干擾模型、jamming waveform、shielding / OTA chamber setup、測試流程、automation、limits 或結果。

軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing
[[軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中針對 military / aviation drones 在 unforgiving electromagnetic environment、multi-domain operations 與 system-level effects 下的測試標準與 solution 線索。
